title: Developer - Integrations & AI
description:
Position Summary
The Developer - Integrations & AI role builds and maintains the connections between Bluum ’s business systems, outside platforms, and the organization’s AI services. Working alongside senior developers, technical leads, and outside development partners, you will help build the APIs, scripts, and web application code that move data between internal applications and approved AI tools, and extend customizations in Bluum ’s core business platforms. You will contribute to AI-enabled features, working from established patterns rather than building the underlying framework, while gaining hands-on experience with applied AI integration.
Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain web application, integration, and automation code using JavaScript, Python, and PHP, including the scripts and services that support AI-enabled features and data preparation.

• Build and maintain integrations that connect internal systems to outside resources, including partner and vendor platforms, third-party APIs, and hosted services.

• Serve as a technical point of contact for outside development resources, vendors, and partners, coordinating requirements, reviewing delivered work, and supporting handoff into internal systems.

• Integrate business applications with the organization’s internal AI services and approved AI tools, working from established patterns rather than building the underlying framework.

• Support and extend customizations, workflows, and configurations within the organization’s core business platforms.

• Collaborate with technical leads, Business Intelligence, and business users to gather requirements and translate them into working solutions.

• Participate in testing, debugging, and documentation of integrations, customizations, and AI-enabled features.

• Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to business applications, workflows, integrations, and connected services.

• Follow established version control and change control practices, and contribute to documentation of processes, code, and user guides.

• Perform other support and development-related tasks as assigned.

• Stay up to date with current development languages, integration patterns, and emerging technology practices through training and mentorship.

Education & Skill Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; relevant coursework or equivalent practical experience accepted.

• Working knowledge of JavaScript and related web technologies, and of Python for scripting, automation, and integration work; experience with PHP is also applicable.

• Familiarity with web development concepts such as HTML, CSS, JSON, and client/server architecture, with experience working with REST APIs and third-party services.

• Exposure to AI or LLM-enabled application development, such as calling model APIs, working with prompts, or consuming an internal AI service.

• Experience with version control tools (e.g., Git).

• Exposure to customizing or extending enterprise business platforms, such as Oracle NetSuite, is a plus but not required, as is basic familiarity with SQL or relational database concepts.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to communicate clearly and work effectively with technical and non-technical team members, including outside vendors and partners.

• Eagerness to learn new technologies and take on technical challenges in a collaborative environment.

Core Values

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Systems Engineer with a focus on High Performance Computing (HPC). You will work alongside senior engineers and Cybersecurity teams to build and maintain next-generation computational, networking, and storage capabilities across the enterprise.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build and maintain scalable, hybrid HPC architectures that span on-premise and cloud environments, working within established architectural patterns

• Support day-to-day operations of existing HPC cluster systems to ensure systems are performant and available

• Implement and test secure multi-tenant capabilities to support consolidation of resources

• Evaluate and test new HPC technologies, both hardware and software, and present findings to senior engineers

• Develop expertise in HPC systems and contribute technical recommendations to the team's classified HPC strategy

• Support DevSecOps processes and help maintain Continuous Integration / Continuous Development (CI/CD) pipelines for automating Infrastructure and Policy as Code (IaC/PaC)

• Work with business lines and classified IT to gather requirements and help develop solutions that meet their needs on time and on budget

• Contribute to HPC requirements documentation and support vendor evaluation efforts, including reviewing proposals and drafting Statements of Work (SOW)

• Create and maintain training materials and runbooks to help users leverage HPC capabilities and tools for Modeling & Simulation (M&S) activities

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Knowledge of and experience with Linux Operating Systems (OS) such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, Ubuntu, etc.

• Experience with automation & scripting tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, Chef, etc.

• Familiarity with HPC technologies such as parallel/distributed file systems (e.g., Lustre, GPFS, Pure, VAST)

• Familiarity with HPC batch scheduling software (e.g., PBSPro, SLURM)

• Eligible to obtain and maintain a US Top Secret Clearance with customer's approval

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Exposure to container orchestration, such as Kubernetes (k8s), and associated container technologies (Podman, Docker, Shifter, AppTainer/Singularity, etc.)

• Exposure to HPC network technologies such as RDMA over Converged Ethernet Version 2 (RoCEv2), InfiniBand, Slingshot, etc.

• Experience with bare-metal systems provisioning using tools such as xCAT, Warewulf, Bright Cluster Manager, etc.

• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.

• Familiarity with software development and debugging, especially in a parallel environment

• Familiarity with MPI and OpenMP applications and the associated configuration of libraries and dependencies

• Awareness of NIST SP 800-53 controls and their technical implementation to meet cybersecurity requirements

title: Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator
description:
The LMS Administrator is responsible for the effective administration, optimisation, and continuous improvement of the HAAS Learning Management System (Totara), ensuring the platform remains accurate, reliable, compliant, and user-focused. Working closely with the Learning and Development team and key stakeholders across HAAS, the LMS Administrator provides expert operational support, manages system processes and data quality, responds to user enquiries, and delivers meaningful learning analytics and reports. The role contributes to the ongoing enhancement of the learner experience by identifying opportunities to streamline processes, improve system functionality, and maximise engagement with digital learning solutions.
The successful candidate will be a highly organised and customer-focused professional with strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, and a passion for learning technologies. They will act as a trusted point of expertise for system users, helping to ensure that the LMS delivers an accessible, efficient, and effective learning environment that supports organisational objectives.

• Ability to produce clear reports and respond to ad‑hoc data requests.

• Strong customer‑service mindset with the ability to support users at all levels.

• Good written and verbal communication skills with experience collaborating with SMEs.

• Strong understanding of LMS administration, including back-end configuration, workflows, and user management.

• Experience creating and interpreting LMS dashboards and reporting tools.

• Ability to extract, analyse, and present data clearly to support decision making and compliance monitoring.

• Flexible, proactive, and able to work effectively as part of a dispersed team - travelling occasionally when required.

• Driven and flexible.

title: Sr. Product Operations Manager I
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Sr. Product Operations Manager I, VR International

Our Mission is to Protect Life

We are out to make the world a safer place by solving big problems and tackling the toughest challenges in public safety. From Axon's inception building the TASER device to today's ecosystem of connected hardware and software, our focus is helping officers and agencies serve their communities with confidence, safety, and integrity. Our moonshot is bold: reduce gun-related deaths between police and the public by 50% in 10 years.

 

Virtual Reality training is a key part of that mission, enabling officers to practice de-escalation, empathy, and tactical decision-making in immersive, realistic environments. Agencies around the world are asking for it, and Axon is now scaling its VR training platform into new international markets, with launches underway or planned across Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific.

Your Impact

International expansion for Axon VR is picking up momentum and has significant potential, and we are only starting to scratch the surface. As we grow and scale, we are discovering what it takes to deploy VR training in each new market, and how needs differ by culture, region, and language. What made us successful in the US and Canada does not translate one-for-one, and every region, including EMEA, LATAM, and APAC, has its own needs.

 

As the Sr. Product Operations Manager I for VR International, you will be the key operational partner to the in-market International VR GTM Lead, who leads international strategy, pricing, and new market prioritization. Together, you will build the operational foundation that lets us expand with confidence. That means putting the right structure and processes in place so each market has what it needs, including localized content, quotes and price books that work, inventory in local warehouses, trained teams, Trial and Evaluation (T&E) kits, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). This is a role with room to grow and scale as the business does.

 

In line with the defined strategy, you will help define the foundation, put it to work in each new market, and refine it as we learn. You will work with international teams, distribution partners, and US-based teams, including Sales, Sales Engineering, Professional Services and Training, Supply Chain, Marketing, Proposals, Legal, Compliance, and Hardware Product Management.

 

Your work will turn international VR from a series of one-off launches into a repeatable, scalable motion that helps bring Axon's mission to agencies around the world.

What You'll Do

Reports To: Sr Director, VR Hardware & Operations

Direct Reports: None, individual contributor role

Work Location: This role is based out of our Boston, MA office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. Boston provides meaningful morning overlap with European and international partners and afternoon overlap with our West Coast-based VR team members.

title: L2 Support Engineer

Position Summary
A second-level support role involves diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues that have been escalated from the first level of support. This role requires advanced knowledge of hardware, software, and networks. Key responsibilities include advanced troubleshooting, managing escalated tickets, providing technical guidance to junior staff, and documenting solutions.
The Helpdesk Technician - Tier II plays a crucial role within the Help Desk, acting as a critical escalation point. This role is instrumental in driving operational excellence by ensuring compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and providing a high-touch customer experience. Additionally, the Helpdesk Technician - Tier II collaborates seamlessly with the Infrastructure team to optimize the end-user technology ecosystem and maintain business continuity across the company.
Responsibilities

• Troubleshoot complex issues by diagnosing, resolving or providing root-cause analysis of incidents across complex hardware, software, and network platforms.

• Receive, prioritize, and manage support ticket workflows in the ITSM systems, ensuring alignment with SLA/OLA thresholds and proactive communication with departments regarding service impacts.

• Document solutions by creating and maintaining detailed documentation of all technical issues, steps taken, and resolutions to build a knowledge base to reduce repeat incident volume.

• Participate in problem management initiatives, identifying systemic issues and recommending strategic solutions to reduce incident recurrence.

• Partner with Tier 1 Technicians to mentor, reinforce knowledge transfer around emerging technologies and best practices while improving the overall team's efficiency.

• Identify and escalate critical or unresolved issues to Level 3 support, providing detailed handover information.

• Support on-site and remote workforce environments, ensuring seamless user experience across hybrid, multi-site, and distributed operating models.

Required Qualifications

• 3-5 years of Help Desk support experience, with at least 1-2 years in a Tier II capacity within an enterprise environment.

• Strong proficiency in Windows Server/Client OS (e.g., Windows, Linux, macOS), Active Directory, Azure AD/Microsoft Entra ID, software applications (e.g., M365/Microsoft Office), cloud service platform (e.g., Azure Virtual Desktop/ AVD), network fundamentals (e.g., DHCP, DNS, VPN) and standard enterprise management tools (ServiceNow, NinjaOne).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify root causes of complex issues while using remote access tools.

• Excellent communication and customer service skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.

• Focused mindset on delivering value-added engagement with end users at all touchpoints.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently with minimal supervision, and pivot rapidly in a dynamic support landscape while maintaining quality of service.

Preferred Qualifications

• Associate degree from an accredited institution with 3+ years of Help Desk experience OR

• High school diploma or GED equivalent, with 5+ years of Help Desk experience can be substituted for a degree

• IT Certifications: CompTIA Certification A+, Network+, or Security+

• Exposure to virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, Citrix) and cloud service ecosystems (Azure, AWS, GCP).

title: Product Design Lead (Canada)
description:
This is a fully remote role based in Canada. Candidates may work from anywhere within Canada.

About Proof

We’re Proof , a high-growth company in the legal tech industry, founded in 2017. We’ve built a best-in-class platform trusted by thousands of law firms across the United States for Service of Process, the formal delivery of legal documents, and E-Filing. We connect law firms with process servers and enable electronic court filing, delivering over a million documents per year through a network of thousands of process servers. We’re working to make the legal system more efficient, transparent, and accessible than it’s traditionally been.

Design at Proof

We design for the whole service, not just the interface. We aren't a downstream team turning tickets into screens; we help the company understand complex problems, make ambiguity concrete, and decide what should become simpler before more gets built.

Design isn't an approval gate that every decision has to pass through. Depending on the work, we may lead the problem framing, partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to explore a solution, or help a team improve work already underway. The goal is to bring the right level of design involvement while important decisions are still open.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to take on challenging product and service workflows, with a primary focus on the onboarding workflows that power legal document delivery.

Delivering documents in the real world comes with inevitable edge cases and complications. An action in the field ripples through our internal systems and what a law firm sees. For example, if a process server finds a recipient has moved, the law firm needs clarity, internal teams need to resolve the exception, and the delivery workflow changes. Designing here means understanding those connections and deciding whether the right intervention is software, a process shift, automation, or all three.

You’ll report directly to the Director of Design on a small, high-leverage team, partnering with Product, Engineering, and Operations leadership to frame ambiguous problems, explore tradeoffs, and shape direction before solutions are locked in.

You’ll have meaningful autonomy to frame problems, choose the right approach, and drive work forward, with close cross-functional partnership, not a prescribed playbook.

What you’ll do

• Own complex workflows end-to-end: Aid in framing problems, navigate ripple effects across operations, servers, and customers, and drive through to delivery.

• Prototype to learn: Build prototypes at the right fidelity to test assumptions, make ideas tangible, and help teams make clear decisions early.

• Work with the hood open: Share unfinished work early, invite critique, and partner with Product, Engineering, and operations while problems are still malleable.

• Design whole systems, not just screens: Create coherent workflows, interfaces, information architecture, and states across digital tools and operational processes.

• Contribute to the practice: Create and improve interaction patterns and language within your work that help Operations specialists, process servers, and law firms move through the product without having to re-learn it. Share what you learn and work alongside other designers to strengthen craft and service thinking.

How we work

Part of the work here is strengthening how we build context, shifting toward an everyday habit, not a scheduled research phase. Rather than wait for complete briefs, we dig into the mechanics of the service by shadowing Operations specialists, listening to law-firm calls, talking with process servers, and asking questions until we have a solid understanding. From there, we move fluidly between sketching, prototyping, and writing clear recommendations to help teams make confident decisions while the problem is still open.

title: Controller
description:
The Role:
SPARC Behavioral Health is seeking an experienced Controller to lead full back office accounting operations, including treasury management, and drive process improvement across a growing, multi-entity healthcare organization. This role owns the monthly close, financial statement reporting, and audit preparation, while leading a Senior Accountant and Payroll Specialist and partnering closely with the CFO on broader finance initiatives. The ideal candidate is hands-on, comfortable in a fast paced environment with evolving systems, and motivated to build stronger processes rather than simply maintain existing ones.
The organization is a private equity backed portfolio company, and this role should expect the reporting cadence, lender covenant requirements, and diligence rigor that come with that ownership structure.
AS the Controller, you will have responsibility for:

• Own the monthly close process, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and preparation of financial statements

• Lead treasury and cash management, including cash positioning and bank relationships

• Own payroll end to end, including processing, compliance, and recordkeeping

• Lead and mentor a Senior Accountant and a Payroll Specialist, providing review and development support

• Serve as the organization's NetSuite subject matter expert, maintaining data integrity and troubleshooting system issues

• Lead audit preparation and serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors

• Maintain and strengthen internal controls across accounting functions

• Support intercompany accounting and reconciliations across multiple entities

• Support tax compliance and reporting, including coordination with external tax preparers on income tax provisions, multi-state filings, and any sales/use tax obligations across entities

• Partner with the CFO on ad hoc financial analysis, technical accounting questions, lender and investor reporting, and special projects

• Assist with policy documentation and standardization of accounting procedures

Experience

• BA and CPA required

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2 years in a Controller or Assistant Controller capacity

• Hands on NetSuite experience strongly preferred

• Experience owning or closely overseeing payroll processing, including compliance, recordkeeping, and payroll tax knowledge

• Strong technical accounting knowledge (GAAP) with demonstrated experience preparing financial statements

• Experience managing or mentoring staff

• Prior experience supporting external audits and preparing audit ready documentation

• Experience in a private equity backed or investor reported environment strongly preferred

• Healthcare, behavioral health, or multi site services industry experience a plus, including familiarity with multi payer, multi state revenue considerations

• Track record of improving or building accounting processes, not just executing existing ones

• Strong communication skills and comfort operating with some ambiguity in a lean finance team

You’ll guide customers through onboarding, ensure payroll runs smoothly, resolve issues quickly, and build long-term trust through proactive communication. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who enjoys helping people, learning systems, and turning complex topics into clear next steps.## What You’ll Do* Own customer relationships for timelines and deliverables* Help customers run payroll accurately and on time by coordinating inputs, reviewing common issues, and escalating when needed* Troubleshoot payroll-related questions (pay title: Databricks Data Engineer
description:
Jsme Microsoft Data Platform Competence Center, přední odborníci na Microsoft datové technologie. Máme reálné zkušenosti se všemi trendy datových technologií, jako je Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Power BI, Purview, SQL Database, Palantir, Oracle a další. Neustále se učíme nové funkce a ladíme naše postupy, tím se stále zlepšujeme, testujeme a implementujeme nové inovace v oblasti dat a AI.
Naši lidé jsou pro nás klíčoví. Je nás už 40 v týmu a působíme jak v Česku, tak ve Švýcarsku.
Hledáme Mid až Senior Data Engineera se silnou znalostí Databricks , který bude podporovat velkou finanční instituci při návrhu, optimalizaci a provozu big-data řešení . Jedná se o hands-on roli, vhodnou pro zkušeného specialistu, který dokáže pracovat samostatně, převzít odpovědnost za datové pipeline. Staneš se součástí datového týmu zaměřeného na škálovatelná, produkčně nasaditelná řešení využívající Databricks, PySpark a Delta Lake, s důrazem na automatizaci, CI/CD a DevOps / MLOps best practices.
Co tě čeká:

• Návrh, vývoj a optimalizace datových pipeline na Databricks pomocí PySpark a Delta Lake

• Vývoj a údržba robustních a škálovatelných big-data řešení s důrazem na výkon a spolehlivost

• Podpora automatizace a orchestrace datových workflow pomocí Jenkins

• Uplatňování DevOps / MLOps principů pro plynulé nasazování a provoz v produkčním prostředí

• Podílení se na optimalizaci produkčního provozu , včetně nákladové efektivity (FinOps)

• Práce s Databricks Asset Bundles pro standardizované a opakovatelné deploymenty

• Úzká spolupráce se stakeholdery, aktivní upřesňování požadavků a konstruktivní zpochybňování nejasných zadání

• Monitoring, řešení problémů a průběžné zlepšování existujících datových pipeline

Jak si tě představujeme:

• Praktická zkušenost s Databricks.

• Silná praktická znalost PySpark a Delta Lake

• Dobré porozumění big-data zpracování , datovým pipeline a produkčnímu data engineeringu

• Zkušenost s CI/CD pipeline a Jenkins

• Znalost DevOps / MLOps přístupů v kontextu data engineeringu

• Schopnost pracovat samostatně , převzít odpovědnost a jasně komunikovat v komplexním prostředí

•
Silné analytické myšlení a schopnost řešit problémy

Výhodou:

• Zkušenost z oblasti bankovnictví nebo finančních služeb

• Znalost FinOps nebo optimalizace nákladů v cloudových platformách

• Databricks certifikace (Associate nebo Professional)

Poznáváš se? Skvělé! U nás ti dáme podporu, pro vše, co potřebuješ a příležitost zazářit!

Co nabízíme:

• Možnost pracovat z domova nebo i kanceláře, tak jak ti to vyhovuje (žádné omezování)

• Až 30 dní volna na osobní a firemní rozvoj, školení dle vlastního výběru (MS certifikace, zahraniční konference, školení...)

• Budget na rozvoj

• Moderní, prostorná kancelář v centru Prahy s terasou, grilem a vlastní pípou a možností využití terasy i pro osobní účely a akce

• Ergonomicky vybavené pracovní místo (polohovatelný stůl, nastavitelná a pohodlná židle, velký monitor nebo dva), pracovní místo v tiché místnosti nebo open space, dle preferencí

• Multisport karta

• Navíc ti dáme předplatné Microsoft Visual Studio Enterprise (MPN), včetně cca $100 měsíčně na hraní si v prostředí Azure

• Plnou licenci RedGate SQL Toolbelt

• Žádné přesčasy

• Občerstvení je stále k dispozici (ovoce, káva, čaj, nealko, čokoláda, oříšky, pivo …)

Zaujalo? Skvělé, máme radost.
Pošli nám svůj životopis a Justýna nebo Martina se ti ozvou co nejdříve a domluví se s tebou na online setkání.
Těšíme se!

title: US Payroll Specialist
description:
Position: Payroll Specialist
Position Summary
• The Payroll Specialist supports our growing client base and is responsible for all payroll-related processing activities.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
• Responsible for processing client payrolls in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.
• Knowledge of time clock systems, voluntary payroll deductions, federal/state/local taxation, and quality assurance.
• Pull new hire imports and timesheet imports.
• Resolve client/employee issues or discrepancies with payroll data and provide problem resolution.
• Ensure accurate and timely payroll processing and employee payments.
• Review and calculate pay for status changes, new hires, transfers, and promotions.
• Calculate terminated employees' final pay following applicable state laws and regulations.
• Troubleshoot and resolve employee payroll and HRIS issues or concerns.
• Make necessary entries or uploads to payroll data (adjustments, incentives, additional hours) after approvals and documentation are received.
• Prepare off-cycle payrolls and manual checks as needed.
• Respond to HRIS and payroll inquiries.
• Respond to all VOEs (Verification of Employment).
• Enter new hire information into the HRIS.
• Provide technical expertise and guidance to employees on HRIS functions and processes.
• Manage, maintain, and update HRIS and specific modules.
• Manage employee files (active and inactive), I-9s, etc.
• Assist with setup of new payrolls and/or companies.
• Generate reports as requested for compliance and audits.
• Perform other duties and projects as assigned.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
• Ability to organize work to meet daily and weekly deadlines.
• Ability to multitask with strong attention to detail.
• Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment.
• Intermediate to strong skills in MS Office, including Excel and Outlook.
• Use logic and reasoning to make immediate decisions under pressure or tight deadlines.
• Proven ability to make sound judgment calls when presented with situations/problems.
• Collaborate with other departments to find resolutions.
Marginal Functions
• Continued education via webinars, trainings, and other learning and development opportunities.
Education & Experience
• High school diploma or equivalent.
• 1-2 years of experience.
• Experience with PRISM preferred but not required.
• PEO experience preferred but not required.
Required Licenses And/Or Certifications
• None.
Physical, Mental, & Communication Demands
• Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.
• Frequently required to sit; occasionally required to stand and walk.
• Must be able to remain in a stationary position 75-100% of the time and occasionally move about the building to access copiers, filing cabinets, or retrieve mail.
• Must constantly communicate with team members and employees.
• Constantly operates a computer and other office equipment (keyboard, mouse, printer, scanners, fax, copier).
• Repetitive motions that may include wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
• Requires constant mental assessment of accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of assigned work.
• Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, and ability to adjust focus.
• Moderate concentration/intensity, including prolonged mental effort.
• Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
• May occasionally move objects up to 20 lbs throughout the office.

title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
description:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.
Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S

The Principal Data Platform Engineer, Snowflake is the platform administrator and technical lead for Enlyte's Snowflake environment and its supporting tooling. This role takes over day-to-day management of the platform, ensuring it is secure, reliable, well-integrated, and supportable as Enlyte's data footprint grows.
This senior individual contributor builds and supports integrations, applies security controls to protect regulated claims data, and partners with tech leads across Technology Engineering & Platforms to establish observability and platform management standards. The role is a key part of the organization's transition to a product delivery model.

• Monitor platform health and performance; troubleshoot issues and support resolution of Snowflake-related incidents

• Serve as the technical point of contact for the Snowflake vendor relationship, including support cases, roadmap, and new feature evaluation

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Snowflake in a production enterprise environment

• Strong experience building and supporting data integrations (Snowpipe, connectors, APIs, ETL/ELT tooling)

• Strong cloud engineering experience, primarily AWS, including the services that integrate with Snowflake

• Strong SQL skills and scripting experience (Python or similar)

• Experience implementing security controls for sensitive or regulated data (PHI/PII, HIPAA)

• Strong communication skills with the ability to partner with and influence technical leaders

Preferred Qualifications:

• SnowPro Core and SnowPro Advanced: Administrator or Architect certification

• Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools for Snowflake management

• Experience with observability and monitoring tools for data platforms

title: Senior Product Manager - Retrieval
description:
Senior Product Manager - Retrieval | Storage, Peripherals & Retrieval | Hybrid Working | Hatfield

About Us

We are Ocado Group and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role

Storage, Peripherals & Retrieval is the product area behind the automated systems at the heart of Ocado's automated warehouses: the grid, the peripherals and the bots that run on it. Our mission is to develop the world's leading ASRS: highly cost-competitive, reliable, easy to launch and support and suitable for diverse global use cases.

As the Senior Product Manager for Retrieval, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for our bot, battery and charger fleet. Retrieval is the core driver of grid movement - bots transport stock and customer orders between grid locations, stations and ports, meaning every customer order depends on their availability, reliability and cost-effectiveness.

Operating at the intersection of hardware, firmware, wireless and cloud software, you will lead a critical product domain where even a small change to a bot scales across every operational site globally. You will collaborate closely with mechanical, mechatronics, firmware, wireless and cloud engineering teams, as well as manufacturing and field support teams, driving complex problem-solving and cross-domain alignment.

Key Responsibilities

• Product Vision & Strategy: Shape and execute the product vision for complex initiatives across the bot, battery and charger domain, balancing short- and long-term goals to lower Capex, Opex and lead time.

• Commercial & Data Leadership: Define key domain metrics connected directly to business outcomes. Manage financial rationale, balance KPI impacts and make informed Build vs. Buy decisions.

• Execution & Problem Solving: Lead discovery and problem-solving across cross-functional teams, setting high standards for scoping, requirements and data-driven hypothesis testing.

• Product Adoption & Scale: Build adoption metrics into domain capabilities, monitor usage across customer segments and collaborate with Solutions, Partner Growth and Partner Success teams to drive global rollout.

• Stakeholder Management & Evangelism: Manage relationships across engineering crafts, leadership levels and external partners. Articulate complex technical decisions clearly and build strong buy-in.

• Domain Expertise & Leadership: Serve as the recognized go-to expert for Retrieval, providing strategic guidance, mentoring surrounding PMs and stepping into leadership moments for the Product Director when needed.

What We’re Looking For

• Substantial, battle-tested product management experience owning end-to-end product lifecycles for complex engineering products shipped at scale.

• Proven track record of leading product discovery, setting product strategy in uncertain environments and making high-impact strategic trade-offs.

• Strong experience building product roadmaps alongside Design and Engineering peers, owning the business case and ROI.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, UX, Data, delivery teams and external partners or clients.

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment and deliver on commitments.

Nice to Haves

• Experience with products that combine hardware and software (e.g., robotics, connected devices or industrial automation).

• Experience mentoring or coaching other Product Managers.

title: Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analyst (Senior)
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks two Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts to provide experienced customer-facing technical support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. These positions receive and assess incidents and service requests, resolve approved first-contact and Tier 2 issues, maintain complete ticket records, confirm service restoration, and escalate potential outage signals.
Senior Analysts handle complex or high-priority cases within the Tier 1/2 support scope and provide technical guidance to less-experienced service-desk personnel. They help ensure that tickets are accurately prioritized, thoroughly documented, resolved through approved procedures, and escalated to the appropriate technical team when necessary.
The Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts support issues involving computer hardware, software, operating systems, networks, telecommunications, websites, portals, user access, audio-visual equipment, and enterprise connectivity. They work closely with service-desk leadership, field support, network and systems administrators, cybersecurity personnel, application teams, engineering teams, and Government stakeholders.
These positions are remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Analysts must be able to work assigned shifts and support after-hours, weekend, holiday, or surge coverage when required.
Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analyst will:

• Serve as an experienced initial point of contact for USMEPCOM users requiring technical support.

• Receive incidents and service requests through approved telephone, email, website, self-service, monitoring, and escalation channels.

• Create complete and accurate ServiceNow records for incidents, requests, problems, customer contacts, and technical actions.

• Verify customer identity, contact information, location, affected service, operational impact, urgency, and relevant equipment or system information.

• Categorize, prioritize, assign, route, and track incidents and requests in accordance with approved procedures.

• Resolve approved first-contact issues using established diagnostic procedures, scripts, knowledge articles, known-error information, and remote-support tools.

• Support approved user-account, password, authentication, and access-management activities.

• Troubleshoot email, collaboration, browser, productivity software, and enterprise-application issues.

• Provide remote technical support and guide users through approved diagnostic, recovery, and restoration procedures.

• Apply approved workarounds when a permanent resolution is not immediately available.

• Determine when an incident requires field support, system administration, network, application, cybersecurity, engineering, vendor, or other specialized assistance.

• Escalate incidents that exceed the analyst’s authority, technical capability, service-level target, or approved support scope.

• Identify and immediately escalate potential outage signals, including multiple related incidents, widespread connectivity failures, significant service degradation, or loss of mission-critical functionality.

• Document initial outage symptoms, affected users and locations, business impact, start time, troubleshooting actions, and available technical evidence.

title: Senior Clinical Data Associate - South Africa - FSP
description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel , we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.
Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel , contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.
About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.
About the Role
We are seeking a Senior Clinical Data Associate to join our team in South Africa in a remote capacity.

As a Senior Clinical Data Associate, you will support global clinical research programs by delivering high-quality data management activities across Phase I-IV clinical studies. This position plays a key role in clinical data quality, regulatory compliance, study execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

You will partner with clinical teams, statisticians, programmers, CRAs, vendors, and study management teams to ensure accurate and timely data collection, review, reconciliation, and database management activities. title: Machine Learning Engineer, Synthetic Data
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams

Simulation is advancing end-to-end autonomous driving research. The team’s mission is to accelerate AV2.0 by incubating capabilities that become company-level advantages - generative world models and the synthetic data they produce are one of those. The goal of this role is to build, scale, and optimise next-generation world model architectures (GAIA and successors) and bridge them into high-throughput generation and training infrastructure, so synthetic data can dramatically accelerate autonomy development. You will post-train world models for new embodiments and behaviours (rig transfer, pose transfer, dashcam restaging), generate multimodal synthetic experience at scale, and land that data in the same training stack we use for real driving. You sit between ML research and engineering: collaborating with scientists on architecture and conditioning, and with platform engineers on generation jobs, training artefacts, and how synthetic data is mixed into training. Your work will decide how fast we can train, evaluate, and deploy driving models on vehicles we have barely collected from.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Model development: Post-train, distill, and evaluate GAIA-family large video diffusion models to improve generation quality, controllability, and generalisation. Run ablation studies and investigate failures in visual quality, temporal consistency, motion, and action conditioning.

- Generation at scale: Build and run synthetic video generation pipelines across tens of thousands of driving segments. Optimise inference efficiency, manage GPU resources, and ensure data quality throughout the pipeline.

- From generation to training: Integrate synthetic data across different stages of driving-model training, develop sampling strategies, and measure its impact through evaluation suites and on-road performance.

- Cross-team collaboration: Work with driving-model teams to determine effective data mixtures and with simulation and evaluation teams to turn generated scenarios into useful closed-loop tests.

- Applied research: Translate advances in world modelling, video generation, flow matching, distillation, and data-centric training into measurable improvements in the models and data we deploy.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Post-train and iterate GAIA-class world models for synthetic-data capabilities: embodiment transfer (new camera/vehicle embodiments), pose transfer (rewritten ego trajectories), and related conditioning (geometry, calibration, actions).

- Own the generation loop: config → large-scale GPU inference → training-ready artefacts, with clear lineage from the model and settings that produced them.

- Land synthetic data in driving-model training (behaviour cloning, reward models, RL): binarisation, mix ratios, quality filters, and experiments that measure suite and on-road impact - including when synthetic should replace scarce real rig data.Diagnose and fix geometry, artefacts, calibration, and controllability failures that determine whether generated video is training-grade.

- Improve throughput and yield: inference optimisations (distillation, KV cache), valid-generation rate, and self-serve workflows so model developers can request synthetic sets without a specialist.

- Expand coverage to new vehicle platforms and safety-critical scenarios (OEM bring-up; Emergency Lane Keeping / Automatic Emergency Braking).

- Partner with world-model researchers, infra, and driving-model owners so generation, evaluation, and training stay one system.

- 4+ years in applied ML / research engineering, with a track record of training and s

title: Senior Consulting Engineer - EMEA
description:
ClickHouse is the open-source, real-time analytical database behind a lot of today's AI. More than 4,000 companies build on ClickHouse, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Tesla and Meta.

As a Consulting Engineer, you're the hands-on engineer on our customers' most important projects. When a customer needs to migrate, integrate, or prove ClickHouse on a real workload, you work in the build alongside their engineers: you design it, build it, test it and hand it over.

You'll work on a broad mix of projects for customers across EMEA, from moving large workloads off other databases to building new real-time analytics on ClickHouse. Each one is scoped with clear goals from the start, so you know what success looks like and can get stuck in. It's a fast way to build deep experience across lots of different data problems.

The consulting function at ClickHouse is less than a year old, so you'll help shape how ClickHouse delivers this work as the team grows. Between projects you take cases alongside support engineers, which keeps you close to day-to-day support.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Turn customer goals into a scoped project with measurable success criteria, sizing and a timeline

- Design a target architecture and prove it against the customer's own data: schema and engine design, capacity and sizing, proofs of concept

- Do the build: implementation, pipelines and integrations, migration execution, tooling and automation

- Measure it before it matters, with benchmarking, load and functional testing, then support the cutover

- Tune what production reveals, then hand over with an engagement report and knowledge transfer, so the customer's team can run it without you

- Take L1 to L3 cases alongside support engineers when you're between projects

- Feed what you see in the field back to Product and Engineering, and turn your work into reference architectures, knowledge base articles and blog posts

- Work in a constant feedback loop with the Pre-sales team to ensure that the demos and POCs they present are credible when you put them into production

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years delivering hands-on technical work for customers, whether your title was consultant, professional services, solutions architect, senior support, SRE or something else

- Real depth in databases, whether analytical, transactional or relational

- Hands-on SQL. You regularly write complex queries from scratch, and tune and debug them yourself

- You've owned implementations, migrations or POCs for external customers from start to finish

- Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, GCP and/or Azure)

- You've deployed and run workloads on Kubernetes yourself

- You give precise technical answers and explain them clearly

- Fluent English

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with ClickHouse

- Hands-on Splunk experience

- Migrating analytical workloads from systems such as PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery or Elastic

- Terraform

- Data pipelines and streaming, such as Kafka, Kinesis, Spark or Debezium

- Python, Bash or Go

- Involvement in open source, as a user, contributor or community member

GOOD TO KNOW

- This role is remote within EMEA, in a country where ClickHouse already hires

- Travel to customer sites is part of the job, up to 35% of your time, depending on the project: some need none, others weekly visits

- You'll join our EMEA Support Services team, where Support Engineers, Consulting Engineers and TAM Architects work as one team

- You'll be part of the on-call rotation, about one week a quarter, with time off in lieu if you're paged at a weekend

HOW WE HIRE

- A 30-minute call with our recruiter

- A conversation with the hiring manager

- A take-home exercise, designed to take three to four hours, with three working days to complete it

- A 90-minute technical interview with the team: you'll walk us through your take-home, then join a working session where you write and tune SQL live

- A final conversation with our VP of Support Services

- References, then an offer

Je daagt je collega’s uit en vormt gezamenlijk een plan welke inzichten nodig zijn en hoe jij die inzichten het beste kan bouwen en delen met je collega’s. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld een analyse zijn, een dashboard, een rekenmodel of een automatische e-mail feed met verbeter suggesties. title: Senior Data Governance Analyst

As part of the Data Enablement Team, we are seeking a Senior Data Governance Analyst to play a critical, hands-on role in ensuring integrity, quality, and seamless migration of data throughout this transformation. This individual will act as the key liaison between the Data Governance Council, business stakeholders, and technical teams, supporting data governance, mapping, migration, validation, and integration activities to enable a smooth transition to new enterprise platforms.
RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, the Data Governance Council, data domain owners, and technical teams to elicit, document, and prioritize data governance requirements across enterprise data domains.

• Facilitate data governance workshops and working sessions to establish business definitions, data standards, business rules, data definitions, and domain onboarding plans.

• Profile data and analyze source systems and data structures to assess content, quality, and structure, supporting accurate mapping and migration of master data and data hub models.

• Track mapping progress, dependencies, and issues across teams and tools, providing timely updates and resolving blockers.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders and project teams to understand data requirements for HR, Finance, Legal, and Professional Services functions.

• Analyze and document existing data sources, structures, and business rules within legacy systems.

• Develop data mapping specifications to ensure accurate migration to new systems.

• Support the extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data, including profiling, cleansing, and validating migrated data.

• Perform data quality assessments and implement data validation processes to ensure completeness and accuracy.

• Assist in designing and testing data integrations between new enterprise platforms and other business applications.

• Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of data models, flows, and transformation rules.

• Identify and resolve data-related issues during migration and post-implementation.

• Provide regular updates and insights to project leaders and stakeholders regarding data migration progress and risks.

• Support ongoing data governance and quality initiatives as new systems are adopted.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related fields.

• The ideal candidate must have strong experience with data analysis, data profiling, data mapping, and ETL processes.

title: Functioneel Analist Supply Chain en Forecasting (Freelance kan)
description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden
Het energielandschap verandert snel. Als hands-on functioneel analist vorm je de schakel tussen business, supply chain, data en technologie.
Je vertrekt vanuit de bestaande situatie: operationele processen, businesskennis en data die verspreid zijn over verschillende systemen en Excelbestanden. Je duikt tot op het niveau van de brondata, ontleedt bestaande Excelmodellen en brengt de achterliggende businesslogica in kaart.
Vervolgens vertaal je deze inzichten naar een robuust en toekomstgericht datamodel voor nieuwe analytische en voorspellende toepassingen. De focus ligt niet alleen op het rapporteren van historische cijfers. Je gebruikt data en kennis van supply chain om scenario's door te rekenen en toekomstige behoeften, volumes en capaciteiten beter te voorspellen.
Concreet:

• Je analyseert bestaande Excelbestanden en databronnen tot op het laagste relevante detailniveau.

• Je brengt supply-chainprocessen, assumpties, parameters en businesslogica in kaart en bevraagt deze kritisch.

• Je consolideert versnipperde en ongestructureerde data en brengt er structuur in.

• Je vertaalt informatie uit Excel naar gestructureerde data, een datamodel, analytics en forecasting.

• Je ontwerpt een logisch, performant en herbruikbaar datamodel.

• Je werkt mee aan de functionele en data-architectuur van de toekomstige oplossing en documenteert die in een functionele blueprint.

• Je vertaalt voorspellende modellen en scenarioanalyses naar een praktisch bruikbare tool voor de business.

• Je werkt nauw samen met supply-chainexperten, key users, data engineers en andere stakeholders.

• Je volgt een passende projectmethodiek en draagt bij aan een duurzame en schaalbare oplossing, niet alleen aan een analyse of prototype.

📝 Jouw profiel

• Je hebt ervaring als functioneel analist.

• Je hebt kennis van supply chain en forecasting. Ervaring met supply chain en forecasting in de energiesector is relevant voor deze rol.

• Je bent vertrouwd met complexere projectwerking waarbij meerdere stakeholders betrokken zijn.

• Je hebt kennis van data governance.

• Je kunt bestaande Excelmodellen analyseren, ontleden en doorgronden.

• Je kunt datamodellen interpreteren en toepassen.

• Je communiceert sterk en stemt helder af met verschillende stakeholders.

• Je hebt ervaring met Databricks.

• Je kunt werken volgens een projectmethodiek.

• Je kunt een functionele blueprint opstellen.

💼 Aanbod
Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. title: Senior Project Manager, Institutional (资深项目经理，金融机构类客户)
Scientifique de données principal(e)// Senior Data Scientist- Travel Tech
description:
À propos du poste

Hopper Technology Solutions (HTS) propulse le voyage pour certaines des plus grandes marques du monde grâce à nos API, nos produits en marque blanche et notre offre fintech, et chaque jeu de données que nous détenons raconte une histoire que nos partenaires ont besoin de voir racontée clairement, régulièrement et rapidement. À titre de scientifique de données principal(e) au sein d’HTS, vous serez responsable de la relation analytique avec un portefeuille de partenaires et vous bâtirez les mécanismes qui répondent une première fois à leurs questions sur la santé de l’inventaire, la compétitivité des prix et la performance, puis y répondent chaque semaine. Vous serez évalué(e) moins sur la sophistication de vos modèles que sur la capacité des personnes avec qui vous travaillez, chez Hopper comme dans les équipes commerciales de nos partenaires, à prendre de meilleures décisions grâce à vous.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien

- Assumer la responsabilité de la relation analytique avec un portefeuille de partenaires HTS, en travaillant aux côtés des équipes Partner Success et Commercial pour comprendre leurs besoins, y répondre et présenter les résultats directement à leurs équipes

- Concevoir et standardiser des rapports récurrents sur la santé de l’inventaire, la compétitivité des prix et la performance des locataires, qui s’adaptent aux hôtels, aux vols, aux locations de maisons et aux voitures sans devoir être reconstruits chaque fois

- Utiliser les assistants et agents d’intelligence artificielle ainsi que les outils de génération de code comme collaborateurs du quotidien afin d’automatiser les parties répétitives de l’analyse et de la production de rapports, et aider l’ensemble de l’équipe à adopter les mêmes pratiques

- Cadrer et mener des analyses exploratoires qui approfondissent notre compréhension du comportement des partenaires et des voyageurs, et traduire vos constats en recommandations claires pour les responsables produit, ingénierie et affaires

- Appliquer l’apprentissage automatique et les méthodes statistiques à de vastes ensembles de données désordonnés lorsqu’ils font une réelle différence, et reconnaître quand une mesure simple et bien expliquée constitue la meilleure réponse

- Créer des tableaux de bord et des rapports en libre-service dans BigQuery, Looker, Tableau, Amplitude et Google Sheets, avec le souci de vous rendre inutile pour les questions de routine

- Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes produit et ingénierie afin que les données que nous recueillons soutiennent les questions que nos partenaires poseront ensuite

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

- Un diplôme en mathématiques, statistiques, informatique, génie, économie ou dans une autre discipline quantitative, ou une expérience pratique équivalente

- D’excellentes compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes, avec un historique démontré de réponses à des questions complexes à l’aide des données, dans plus d’un domaine ou d’une gamme de produits

- Une capacité démontrée à transformer un travail technique complexe en récits simples et crédibles pour des auditoires non techniques et de direction, y compris des partenaires externes

- De l’aisance en contact avec les partenaires, pour présenter des conclusions, répondre à des questions difficiles en direct et établir un lien de confiance avec les interlocuteurs commerciaux

- De solides compétences en SQL et de l’expérience avec les entrepôts de données modernes comme BigQuery, ainsi qu’une maîtrise de Python et Pandas ou de R pour la préparation et l’analyse de données à grande échelle

- Un usage quotidien et pratique des outils fondés sur les grands modèles de langage, comme Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor ou Copilot, pour écrire du code, du SQL, des analyses et de la documentation, et un point de vue sur leurs forces et leurs limites

- De l’expérience dans la conception ou le déploiement de flux de travail automatisés et agentiques, des pipelines planifiés

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. Your career is more than just a job, it's part of your life. The Clinical Recruiter hires qualified physicians and advanced practice providers. Location: Remote

• Creating a red-carpet treatment in order to hire qualified advanced practice providers. We're looking for a Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Vision AI to architect and build the platform behind these products. You'll have an outsized influence on how Vision AI is built and how it reaches restaurants across Toast. This is a highly hands-on role: you'll spend most of your time designing, building, and shipping, and you'll own the technical direction of the platform.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Architect and build the core platform. Design the video pipeline and other essential components, from how video is captured and ingested to how it's stored, processed, and delivered, so the platform is secure and reliable.

• Own the services that analyze video. Build the services that process footage, run vision models, and turn what they see into observations and metrics restaurants can act on.

• Build ML systems and drive model choices. Select and integrate vision models, including vision-language models, and build the ML systems around them, such as inference pipelines, evaluation, and monitoring of model performance in production. Partner with our ML engineers as models mature.

• Build customer-facing use cases across Toast. Bring vision-powered features to restaurant operators across Toast's products and surfaces.

• Set the technical direction. Make the key architecture decisions for the Vision AI platform, building what's right for today while keeping a clear path to where we're headed.

• Stay hands-on. Write production code, prototype new ideas, and ship. You'll lead through building, not just reviewing.

• Collaborate across orgs. Partner with teams across Toast on integrations, dependencies, and working models when the work calls for it.

• Lead with AI-forward engineering. Use AI coding tools and agent harnesses as a core part of how you design, build, test, and ship, and help the team adopt workflows that make everyone faster.

• Raise the bar. Mentor engineers, set standards for reliability, security, and privacy, and make the platform easier to build on with every use case.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• Deep engineering experience. 10+ years building software, including designing and shipping distributed systems and data pipelines in production at scale.

• Backend and cloud expertise. Strong experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), event-driven systems (e.g. Pulsar or Kafka), storage, and APIs, in Kotlin, Java, or similar languages, plus comfort with Python.

• Experience with ML systems and video. You don't need to be a model researcher, but you understand how models are trained, tuned, and served, and you've built and operated ML systems in production, including inference pipelines, evaluation, and model monitoring. You're also comfortable working with video (streams, codecs, tools like ffmpeg).

• Pragmatic architecture. A track record of designing systems that fit the current stage, avoiding over-engineering while leaving room to grow.

• Zero-to-one experience. Experience taking ambiguous ideas from prototype to production with real customers.

• Hands-on keyboard. You still write significant production code and enjoy doing it.

• AI-forward ways of working. Daily use of AI coding assistants and agent harnesses (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor), and experience building with LLM or vision-language model APIs.

• Collaboration and communication. Ability to align engineers, product partners, and other orgs around technical decisions and explain tradeoffs clearly.
